    /**

    public static function round(mixed $number, mixed $precision): array|string|float

        }

            $number = Helpers::validateNumericNullBool($number);
            $precision = Helpers::validateNumericNullBool($precision);

    /**
     * ROUNDUP.
     *
     * Rounds a number up to a specified number of decimal places
     *
     * @param array|float $number Number to round, or can be an array of numbers
     * @param array|int $digits Number of digits to which you want to round $number, or can be an array of numbers
     *

     *         If an array of numbers is passed as the argument, then the returned result will also be an array
     *            with the same dimensions
     */
    public static function up($number, $digits): array|string|float
    {
        if (is_array($number) || is_array($digits)) {
            return self::evaluateArrayArguments([self::class, __FUNCTION__], $number, $digits);
        }

        try {
            $number = Helpers::validateNumericNullBool($number);
            $digits = (int) Helpers::validateNumericNullSubstitution($digits, null);
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            return $e->getMessage();
        }

        if ($number == 0.0) {
            return 0.0;
        }

        $digitsPlus1 = $digits + 1;
        if ($number < 0.0) {
            if ($digitsPlus1 < 0) {
                return round($number - 0.5 * 0.1 ** $digits, $digits, PHP_ROUND_HALF_DOWN);
            }
            $result = sprintf("%.{$digitsPlus1}F", $number - 0.5 * 0.1 ** $digits);

        }

        if ($digitsPlus1 < 0) {
            return round($number + 0.5 * 0.1 ** $digits, $digits, PHP_ROUND_HALF_DOWN);
        }
        $result = sprintf("%.{$digitsPlus1}F", $number + 0.5 * 0.1 ** $digits);

    public static function odd($number): array|string|int|float
    {

        }

        try {

        $significance = Helpers::returnSign($number);

            $number = Helpers::validateNumericNullBool($number);
            $significance = Helpers::validateNumericNullSubstitution($significance, ($number < 0) ? -1 : 1);

        } catch (Exception $e) {

        $engine->ceilingSignificance = (float) $significance;
        $engine->ceilingMode = (int) $mode;

    public static function ceilingPrecise(mixed $number, $significance = 1): array|string|float

        if (is_array($number) || is_array($significance)) {

                $engine->integerCandidate = 0.0;

            }
        } catch (Exception $e) {

        }

        $returnValue = 1;
        $allPoweredFactors = [];
        foreach ($arrayArgs as $value) {
            $engine->integerWorkspace = (float) $value;
            $engine->floorNumber = (float) $value;
            $engine->integerCandidate = (float) $value;
            $myFactors = $engine->lcmFactors(floor($value));
            $myCountedFactors = array_count_values($myFactors);
            $myPoweredFactors = [];
            foreach ($myCountedFactors as $myCountedFactor => $myCountedPower) {
                $myPoweredFactors[$myCountedFactor] = $myCountedFactor ** $myCountedPower;
            }
            $engine->processPoweredFactors($allPoweredFactors, $myPoweredFactors);
        }
        foreach ($allPoweredFactors as $allPoweredFactor) {
            $returnValue *= (int) $allPoweredFactor;
        }
        $engine->integerWorkspace = (float) $returnValue;
        $engine->floorNumber = (float) $returnValue;

        return $returnValue;
    }

    private function lcmFactors(float $value): array
    {
        $this->integerWorkspace = $value;
        $this->floorNumber = $value;
        $this->integerCandidate = $value;
        $startVal = floor(sqrt($value));
        $factorArray = [];
        for ($i = $startVal; $i > 1; --$i) {
            if (($value % $i) == 0) {
                $factorArray = array_merge($factorArray, $this->lcmFactors($value / $i));
                $factorArray = array_merge($factorArray, $this->lcmFactors($i));
                if ($i <= sqrt($value)) {
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        if (!empty($factorArray)) {
            rsort($factorArray);

            return $factorArray;
        }

        return [(int) $value];
    }

            }
        }
    }
